zh-CN.name: 超文本标记语言
zh-CN.text: 写页面结构的语言：网页上有哪些内容（标题、段落、按钮、图片），都用 HTML 的标签写在 .html 文件里。

en.name: HyperText Markup Language
en.text: The language for page structure: what is on the page (headings, paragraphs, buttons, images) is written with HTML tags in .html files.

zh-CN.name: 层叠样式表
zh-CN.text: 写视觉样式的语言：颜色、字号、间距、布局。CSS 规则通常放在 .css 文件里，用选择器挑出要改的元素。

en.name: Cascading Style Sheets
en.text: The language for visual styling: colours, font sizes, spacing, layout. CSS rules usually live in .css files and use selectors to pick the elements they change.

zh-CN.name: JavaScript 脚本语言
zh-CN.text: 让网页动起来的语言：点击按钮后做什么、怎么改页面上的文字。浏览器运行 .js 文件里的 JavaScript。

en.name: JavaScript
en.text: The language that makes a page interactive: what happens when a button is clicked, how text on the page changes. The browser runs the JavaScript in .js files.

zh-CN.name: 标签
zh-CN.text:
HTML 里用尖括号写的标记，比如

和

。开始标签和结束标签把内容包起来。

en.name: tag
en.text:
A marker in HTML written in angle brackets, such as

and

. An opening and a closing tag wrap the content.

zh-CN.name: 元素
zh-CN.text:
一对标签加上它们中间的内容，比如

你好

就是一个标题元素。JavaScript 和 CSS 操作的都是元素。

en.name: element
en.text:
A pair of tags with the content between them;

Hello

is a heading element. JavaScript and CSS work on elements.

zh-CN.name: 属性（HTML）
zh-CN.text: 写在开始标签里的额外信息，比如 里的 src 和 alt。

en.name: attribute
en.text: Extra information inside an opening tag, such as src and alt in .

zh-CN.name: 选择器
zh-CN.text: CSS 规则开头那部分，决定样式用在哪些元素上：h1 选所有一级标题，.card 选 class 是 card 的元素，#message 选 id 是 message 的元素。

en.name: selector
en.text: The start of a CSS rule that decides which elements the style applies to: h1 picks every top-level heading, .card the elements with class card, #message the element with id message.

zh-CN.name: 属性（CSS）
zh-CN.text: CSS 里要改的那一项，比如 color（文字颜色）、font-size（字号）。写法是“属性: 值;”。

en.name: property
en.text: The thing a CSS declaration changes, such as color (text colour) or font-size. It is written as “property: value;”.

zh-CN.name: 变量
zh-CN.text: JavaScript 里给一个值起的名字，比如 const userName = '小雨';。名字要拼得一模一样（大小写也算），拼错了浏览器就找不到它。

en.name: variable
en.text: A name for a value in JavaScript, such as const userName = 'Yu';. The name must be spelled exactly the same every time (including upper and lower case), or the browser cannot find it.

zh-CN.name: 字符串
zh-CN.text: JavaScript 里用引号括起来的一段文字，比如 '你好！'。引号里的内容会原样显示。

en.name: string
en.text: A piece of text in quotes in JavaScript, such as 'Hello!'. What is inside the quotes is shown as it is.

zh-CN.name: 函数
zh-CN.text: 一段起了名字、可以反复执行的代码，比如点击按钮时运行的 function () { … }。

en.name: function
en.text: A named piece of code that can run again and again, such as the function () { … } that runs when a button is clicked.

zh-CN.name: 事件
zh-CN.text: 页面上发生的事情，比如点击（click）。addEventListener 让 JavaScript 在事件发生时运行一个函数。

en.name: event
en.text: Something that happens on the page, such as a click. addEventListener makes JavaScript run a function when the event happens.

zh-CN.name: 文档对象模型
zh-CN.text: 浏览器根据 HTML 建出来的元素树。JavaScript 通过 DOM 找到元素（比如 document.querySelector）并修改它们。

en.name: Document Object Model
en.text: The tree of elements the browser builds from the HTML. JavaScript uses the DOM to find elements (for example with document.querySelector) and change them.

zh-CN.name: 控制台
zh-CN.text: 显示网页运行时输出和错误的地方。console.log(...) 写的内容会出现在这里。

en.name: console
en.text: Where a running page's output and errors appear. Whatever console.log(...) writes shows up here.

zh-CN.name: 错误信息
zh-CN.text: 浏览器或代码检查报告的原始文字，通常是英文，比如 “userNmae is not defined”。NoobIDE 会给出中文解释，但原文一直保留，方便你搜索教程。

en.name: error message
en.text: The original text the browser or the code checker reports, such as “userNmae is not defined”. NoobIDE explains it, but always keeps the original so you can search tutorials for it.

zh-CN.name: 预览
zh-CN.text: 窗口右边显示网页实际效果的地方。文件保存成功后，预览会自动刷新。

en.name: preview
en.text: The area on the right that shows how the webpage really looks. It refreshes after a file is saved successfully.

zh-CN.name: 自动保存
zh-CN.text: 你停下打字一会儿，或者切到别处时，NoobIDE 会把文件写到磁盘上。顶栏会显示保存状态。

en.name: autosave
en.text: When you pause typing or switch elsewhere, NoobIDE writes the file to disk. The top bar shows the save status.

zh-CN.name: 历史版本
zh-CN.text: NoobIDE 在你电脑上为每个文件自动留下的旧版本（每次保存时）。一次看一个文件，可以比较差异并恢复。它和撤销（Ctrl+Z）不一样，也不是整个项目的检查点。

en.name: local history
en.text: Earlier versions of each file that NoobIDE keeps automatically on your computer whenever you save. You look at one file at a time, compare and restore. It is not undo (Ctrl+Z), and not a checkpoint of the whole project.

zh-CN.name: 检查点
zh-CN.text: 由你命名、记下整个项目此刻所有文件的一份记录（在做 AI 修改或恢复之前也会自动保存一个）。以后可以和现在的项目比较，或把整个项目还原回去。它保存在你的电脑上、NoobIDE 自己的数据文件夹里，不是 Git 这样的版本控制，也不能代替备份。

en.name: checkpoint
en.text: A record of every file of the whole project at one moment, under a name you choose (NoobIDE also takes one automatically before AI changes and restores). Later you can compare the project with it or restore the whole project. It is kept on your computer in NoobIDE’s own data folder; it is not version control like Git, and not a backup.

zh-CN.name: 撤销
zh-CN.text: 在编辑器里退回你刚才的修改（Ctrl+Z，Mac 上是 ⌘Z），只针对正在编辑的那个文件。关闭文件后就不能再撤销了；那时可以用本地历史或检查点。

en.name: undo
en.text: Takes back your last edits in the editor (Ctrl+Z, ⌘Z on a Mac), only in the file you are editing. Once the file is closed it cannot be undone any more; then local history or a checkpoint can help.

zh-CN.name: 差异
zh-CN.text: 两个版本之间哪些行被加上、哪些行被去掉的对比。

en.name: diff
en.text: A comparison of two versions showing which lines were added and which were removed.

zh-CN.name: 项目
zh-CN.text: 你的网页所在的那个文件夹，以及里面所有的文件。它就是电脑上一个普通的文件夹，可以复制、发给别人，或用其他编辑器打开。

en.name: project
en.text: The folder your webpage lives in, with all the files inside it. It is an ordinary folder on your computer: you can copy it, send it or open it in another editor.

zh-CN.name: 文件夹
zh-CN.text: 电脑上存放文件的地方。路径（path）写出它在哪儿，比如 文档/NoobIDE 项目/我的第一个网页。

en.name: folder
en.text: A place on your computer that holds files. Its path says where it is, for example Documents/NoobIDE Projects/My first webpage.

zh-CN.name: 路径
zh-CN.text: 文件的位置写法。网页里引用文件常用相对路径，比如 images/avatar.svg 表示“当前文件旁边 images 文件夹里的 avatar.svg”。大小写要一致。

en.name: path
en.text: How a file's location is written. Webpages usually use relative paths: images/avatar.svg means “avatar.svg in the images folder next to this file”. Upper and lower case must match.

zh-CN.name: 颜色值
zh-CN.text: CSS 里写颜色的方式：十六进制（#ff0000）、rgb(255, 0, 0)、hsl(0, 100%, 50%)，或颜色名（red）。在 .css 文件里，NoobIDE 会在颜色值前画一个小色块；光标放在颜色值上时，状态栏会写出这个值，按“编辑颜色”可以用滑块改它。

en.name: Colour value
en.text: The ways CSS writes a colour: hex (#ff0000), rgb(255, 0, 0), hsl(0, 100%, 50%) or a colour name (red). In .css files NoobIDE draws a small swatch in front of each colour value; with the cursor on one, the status bar writes out the value and “Edit colour” changes it with sliders.
